claim: Cumulative unitary-measurement cancellation is a transition-specific flow-balance principle.
evidence: Telescoping identity and late-time ratios near one at all tested monitoring rates in Checkpoints 01-02.
prohibited_language: Order parameter; universal balance law; transition locator.

claim: The complete central Schmidt spectrum determines the next cross-cut second-Renyi response.
evidence: Exact response theorem requires noncentral purities; fixed-spectrum states have systematically different responses.
allowed_language: The complete central spectrum is insufficient.
prohibited_language: Entropy or the central spectrum fully specifies local entangling susceptibility.

claim: At fixed rank-4 central spectrum, stronger monitoring suppresses the response across the tested families and probes.
evidence: 15/15 locked pooled intervals below zero; 45/45 size-specific intervals below zero; all 30 adjacent point estimates negative.
allowed_language: Robust over the five tested finite-size circuit/measurement families and three probes.
prohibited_language: Thermodynamically universal; proven for all monitored dynamics.

claim: The physical monitoring trend reverses after central-spectrum equalization.
evidence: For all five families the unmatched physical endpoint is positive and the equalized endpoint is negative.
allowed_language: A robust sign reversal in the tested models.

claim: The rank-4 intervention result replicates with an independent stochastic seed.
evidence: 15/15 pooled intervals below zero; all 45 size point estimates and all 30 adjacent point estimates negative.

claim: The Clifford rank-4 result is unconditional over all physical trajectories.
evidence: Rank-4 eligibility is limited in several strongly monitored Clifford cells.
allowed_language: Conditional on rank at least four; supplemented by rank-2 robustness.

claim: A rank-2 intervention gives the same sign with broader Clifford support.
evidence: 15/15 pooled, 45/45 size, and 30/30 adjacent intervals below zero.

claim: For an arbitrary probe ensemble, expected post-gate purity is a two-copy response-operator expectation.
evidence: Swap-operator identity, independent of the numerical model.
prohibited_language: Novelty of the general swap formalism.

claim: A locally dressed fixed two-qubit gate has an exact four-purity response stencil.
evidence: Local two-copy twirl onto span{I,F_a,F_b,F_aF_b}; direct numerical validation.
allowed_language: Exact under the stated local-dressing ensemble.
prohibited_language: Every arbitrary gate ensemble reduces to four ordinary purities without symmetry.

claim: The four stencil coefficients are determined by entangling power and gate typicality.
allowed_language: Exact under the stated normalized invariant definitions.
prohibited_language: Applies unchanged without local input twirling.

claim: Every locally dressed probe is suppressed at fixed spectrum in every primary family.
evidence: Point sufficient inequalities hold in all five families; bootstrap support for the second margin is complete in 3/5 primary and 5/5 rank-2 families.
allowed_language: Post-hoc gate-space extension with explicit uncertainty.

claim: Dynamically reachable states reproduce the fixed-spectrum suppression without replacing Schmidt coefficients.
evidence: Exactly spectrum-matched monitored stabilizer states show negative slopes for both Z and random-Pauli monitoring, all three probes, all tested sizes, and an independent seed.
allowed_language: Physical exact-spectrum replication in monitored Clifford/stabilizer circuits.

claim: In the physical stabilizer arm, stronger monitoring increases the neighboring-cut purity sum at fixed central spectrum.
evidence: Both protocols in the main and independent runs have positive confidence intervals; the exact response identity gives the corresponding negative susceptibility slopes.
prohibited_language: A causal effect conditional on post-dynamics rank.

claim: The effect locates or characterizes a measurement-induced critical point.
evidence: n<=14 in the intervention, three p values there, and no predeclared scaling analysis.
allowed_language: Monitoring dependence over the tested finite-size grid.
prohibited_language: Critical exponent; order parameter; transition locator.

claim: Checkpoint 04 reproduces the unavailable historical simulator.
evidence: All results use independently written simulators.
prohibited_language: Exact reproduction of the historical generator.
